changelog:
DARK MUSIC 1.50 — SoundCloud playback fix

- SoundCloud: prefer AAC HLS streams, the current SoundCloud streaming format.
- ExoPlayer: add the Media3 HLS module.
- Mark SoundCloud queue items as HLS before ExoPlayer creates the media source, while keeping local downloaded tracks unchanged.
- Keep progressive HTTP as a compatibility fallback when SoundCloud still provides it.
- Preserve the existing Home catalog, search, widget, Android Auto, playlists, favorites and other providers.

Note: playback remains subject to SoundCloud track availability, regional restrictions and rights/DRM protection.
